ST. MICHAEL'S CHURCH 225 JEROME STREET BROOKLYN 7, N.Y. Nov. 21 - 1945 -
Presentation of B1. Mother Mary in Temple Deo Graties
Miaa Doris Panyard Muskegon, Michigan
Dear Miss Panyard:
God bless you and yours --- with a thousand thanks for the perfect job on the " .... Cure for the Blues" - and the few copies. Glad too that Grandma had such a happy birth-day cele- bration - Many happy returns please God.
Best Wishes and God's blessing to all
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
